verses.text: [For the choirmaster For strings Psalm Song] May God show kindness and bless us, and make his face shine on us.
Then the earth will acknowledge your ways, and all nations your power to save.
Let the nations praise you, God, let all the nations praise you.
Let the nations rejoice and sing for joy, for you judge the world with justice, you judge the peoples with fairness, you guide the nations on earth.
Let the nations praise you, God, let all the nations praise you.
The earth has yielded its produce; God, our God has blessed us.
May God continue to bless us, and be revered by the whole wide world.
